name: CSN 3109 风挡裂纹 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 3109, you are approaching VYK, maintaining 4500 meters, squawking 3125, make initial contact with Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3109，正接近 VYK，保持 4500 米，应答机 3125，与北京管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, approaching VYK, maintaining 4005 hunderd meters, squawking 3215.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，正接近 VYK，保持 4005 hunderd 米，应答机 3215。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, Beijing Control, radar contact, direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，北京管制，雷达识别，直飞 VYK，飞越 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VYK，飞越 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request Beijing Control for a right turn to avoid the thunderstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求北京管制右转避开雷暴。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，我们的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, negative due military activity, turn left heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，不行，因军事活动，左转航向 010。

cards.audioText: B: Now there is a strong E of thunderstorm, you are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在有强雷暴回波，你离天气太近，请求左转避让。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, there is a strong E of thunderstorm, we are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，有强雷暴回波，我们离天气太近，请求左转避让。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, left turn is not permitted due restricted area.
suddenly, you have suffered from hail strike, you left wind shield has cracked, report it to Beijing Control and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 你突然遭遇冰雹撞击，左侧风挡开裂，向北京管制报告并请求返场落地。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, we have had a hail strike, our left wind shield has cracked, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，我们遭遇冰雹撞击，左侧风挡开裂，请求返场落地。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, roger, turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，收到，右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降至并保持 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降至并保持 5100 米，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, descend to 4,200 meters, contact Beijing Approach 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，下降至 4,200 米，联系北京进近 119.25。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, you have got information K, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 4200 米，在 VYK 上空，已收到通播 K，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 3109, maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 3109，保持 4200 米，VYK 上空，通播 K。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, Beijing Approach, radar contact, follow VYK-05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，北京进近，雷达识别，执行 VYK-05 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: VYK-05 arrival, ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: VYK-05 进场，ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, neither of you can see through the windshield due to crack windshield, you ask Beijing Tower if Beijing Airport permits auto-land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近中，由于风挡开裂，你们两人都无法透过风挡看清，询问北京塔台北京机场是否允许自动着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3109, neither of us can see through the windshield due to crack windshield, does your airport permit auto-land ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3109，由于风挡开裂，我们两人都无法透过风挡看清，你机场是否允许自动着陆？

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, Runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 350, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，Runway 36R，许可落地，地面风向 350，风速 3 米/秒。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，由于风挡开裂，你看不清滑行道，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3109, we can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3109，由于风挡开裂，我们看不清滑行道，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，保持位置，牵引车很快会来。
